_about: The single source of truth for this platform: what it accepts and what we have learned about it. Every skill, job and script that makes or posts videos for it reads this file; put new findings here, not anywhere else. maxSeconds is the platform's limit. A video longer than that never goes out cut: the video build makes a separate version for this platform of at most versionSeconds, with its own hook, payoff and end card (data.versions.<platform>), and the publisher posts it only when that version exists.
notes: Our HyperFrames renders fail Instagram processing as they come (rupload ProcessingFailedError), at any length: a 29 s version failed on 2026-11-16 while the same file re-encoded with ffmpeg libx264 (crf 20, yuv420p, aac 128k, faststart) posted fine. The publisher re-encodes Instagram's copy (data.igDriveId). The earlier '40 s limit' was this, not a length limit.
maxSeconds is 90 until a longer re-encoded post is tested. A video over it gets its own version of at most versionSeconds, never a truncated copy.
The grid and feed show an early frame: the headline must be readable from frame 0.
No private or scheduled posts through the API.
